THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:9119  MFA No. 100826 of 2020  JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
challenging the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal seeking enhancement of compensation,
as the Tribunal has awarded inadequate compensation.
2. The factum of the accident, liability and death occurred are not in dispute.
3. The deceased died in the road accident.

The Tribunal has passed judgment and award by awarding compensation under various heads as follows:
1. Loss of dependency Rs.13,06,800/-
 Medical expenses of the  2. Rs.7,000/-
 deceased  3. Loss of consortium Rs.40,000/-
Transportation of dead body and 4. Rs.15,000/-
funeral expenses.
5. Loss of Estate Rs.15,000/-
6. Love and affection Rs.1,00,000/-

Total Rs.14,83,800/-
 rounded off Rs.14,84,000/-
 NC: 2023:KHC-D:9119 Smt.Naazarin W/O.Irfan @ ... vs Mr.John George S/O.Putan George on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182969269/
3 4.

After perusing the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal under various heads as mentioned above are found to be just and proper on loss of dependency, medical expenses of the deceased, transportation of dead body and funeral expenses, and loss of estate, but has awarded less amount towards loss of consortium.
There are totally 6 dependents of the deceased.

Hence, as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of Magma General Insurance Co. Limited v.
Nanu Ram & Others1 and National Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Pranay Sethi 2, the claimants are entitled to Rs.40,000/- each under the head 'Loss of Consortium'.

entities.text: National Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Pranay Sethi 2

sentences.text: Accordingly, Rs.2,40,000/- (Rs.40,000 x 6) is awarded under the head 'Loss of Consortium including Loss of Love and Affection'.

5. Accordingly, Rs.2,40,000/- is awarded under head of loss of consortium but the Tribunal has awarded 2018 ACJ 2782 (2017) 16 SCC 680 NC: 2023:KHC-D:9119 only Rs.1,40,000/- towards loss of consortium and love and affection.
Loss of consortium and loss of love and affection are having similar connotation.

Therefore, the claimants are entitled enhanced compensation of Rs.1,00,000/-
under the head loss of consortium.

6. Therefore, the claimants are entitled enhanced compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal along with interest at 6% per annum from the date of filing of the petition till realization.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 28.08.2019, passed by the learned XI Additional District Judge and Additional M.A.C.T., Belagavi, in MVC No.483/2018 stands modified to the aforesaid extent.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:9119 iii) The claimants are entitled for additional compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- along with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization.
iv) The insurance company shall deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
 v) No order as to costs.
 vi) Draw award accordingly.
